eval_dimensions.name: Orchestration Task Tracking
eval_dimensions.description: Creates the four documented TaskCreate calls at startup (scan, classify, create issues, post audit trail) per references/task-orchestration.md.

eval_dimensions.name: Announce Line
eval_dimensions.description: Opens with the documented announce line identifying the skill before scanning begins.

eval_dimensions.name: Step 2 Grouping Decision Gate
eval_dimensions.description: After classifying and grouping unresolved threads by theme, the skill blocks on AskUserQuestion with the three documented options rather than assuming 'create issues' by default.

evals.name: Startup creates all four orchestration tasks
evals.description: Step 0 must create one TaskCreate per phase (scan, classify, create issues, post audit trail) before scanning begins.

assertions.signal: task_tracking_startup — TaskCreate is called at startup for each of the four orchestration phases

evals.name: Skill opens with the announce line
evals.description: The documented announce line must appear before Step 1 scanning starts, so the user can tell which skill produced the findings.

assertions.signal: announce_line_present — Output contains 'Using Dev10x:gh-pr-doctor to audit merged PRs for unresolved review threads.'

evals.name: Step 2 grouping gate fires with the documented options
evals.description: After presenting grouped findings, the skill must call AskUserQuestion with Create issues / Edit grouping / Dry run rather than proceeding straight to issue creation.
evals.input: /Dev10x:gh-pr-doctor finds 3 unresolved-thread groups (security, error handling, testing) across 5 merged PRs

assertions.signal: gate1_uses_tool — AskUserQuestion is called at the Step 2 grouping decision point, after findings are presented
gate1_options_correct — Options match SKILL.md: 'Create issues (Recommended)', 'Edit grouping', 'Dry run'
gate1_no_plain_text — no inline 'Should I create these issues?' substitutes for the widget

evals.name: Dry run option produces no gh issue create calls
evals.description: When the user selects 'Dry run' at the Step 2 gate, Step 3 (Create Follow-Up Issues) and Step 4 (Post Audit Trail) must not execute — only the findings summary is shown.
evals.input: /Dev10x:gh-pr-doctor --dry-run, user selects 'Dry run' at the gate

assertions.signal: no_issue_create_on_dry_run — 'gh issue create' is never invoked after a Dry run selection

should_trigger: Reviewing merged PRs for accumulated tech debt
Post-merge as part of a maintenance workflow, checking for unresolved review threads
should_not_trigger: Real-time automated PR review during an open PR (use Dev10x:gh-pr-review)
